reviews.summary: Not quite ready: the survey is brief and most questions are clear, but the stress items need reverse-scoring and the outcome about feeling more in control is not directly measured. Add a short open-response question to hear participants’ perspectives; the program-record outcomes do not need to be added to this survey.

applied.problem: More frequent feelings of being overwhelmed indicate worse stress, so higher values should not be treated as better.
More frequent worry indicates worse stress, so higher values should not be treated as better.
There is no open-response question, so participants cannot share their perspective in their own words.
